name: webcmd
description: Self-learning browser infrastructure for AI agents: live browser control plus local sitemap memory that makes repeat runs faster and cheaper.

interface.shortDescription: Self-learning browser control for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Use Webcmd's bundled webcmd-browser skill from Codex to drive a real browser: inspect, click, type, extract, and capture network calls in authenticated sessions. Webcmd keeps sitemap memory locally so later runs need less exploration. Requires the @agentrhq/webcmd npm CLI.
